title: Import your content
subtitle: Bring your videos from YouTube or TikTok to 3Speak. Title, description, tags and thumbnail are filled in for you.

noVideos: No public videos found on this channel.

fallback.intro: You can still import it: download the video yourself and pick the file here. Everything else stays filled in.
fallback.step2: Click the three dots menu and choose Download.
fallback.title: Couldn't fetch this one

errors.signIn: Sign in to import your videos.
errors.blocked: YouTube did not let our server download this video right now.
errors.notVideo: That file is not a video.

errors.notAudio: That file is not an audio file.

tiktok.olderHint: Don't see the video you want?
tiktok.empty: No public TikToks found on your account.

instagram.pasteLabel: Import any of your Instagram videos with its link
instagram.pasteHint: Works for every reel and video post on your account, also older ones. Copy the link from Share → Copy link.
instagram.fallbackStep1: Open the video in the Instagram app.
instagram.empty: No public videos found among your newest Instagram posts.
instagram.olderHint: Don't see the video you want?

batch.maxReached: You can pick up to {{max}} videos at once
batch.busy: Your previous batch is still being imported
batch.contentIntro: Titles, descriptions, tags and thumbnails come from each video.
batch.settingsIntro: These settings apply to all the videos you picked.
batch.shortsNote: Shorts always go to the Shorts feed: the community, blog and ad settings only apply to the regular videos.
batch.spacing: Each video is imported on our server and then published on its own, {{minutes}} minutes apart. The first goes out a few minutes after it is ready. You can close this page.
batch.grantNeeded: To publish while you are away, 3Speak needs permission to post for your account. You can remove it any time in your Hive wallet.
batch.grantPending: Your wallet signed it, but the blockchain does not show it yet. Try again in a moment.
batch.canLeave: You can close this page now. Your videos are imported and published on our server, also while you are away.

status.waitingQuota: Waits for your next free publish time ({{time}})

batch.stopConfirm: Stop this import? Videos that are not published yet are cancelled, including ones already scheduled. Published videos stay.

audio.contentIntro: Pick the kind of audio, and where each post's title, description and tags come from.
audio.settingsIntro: These settings apply to all the episodes you picked.
audio.spacing: Each episode is imported on our server and then published on its own, {{minutes}} minutes apart. The first goes out a few minutes after it is ready. You can close this page.
audio.canLeave: You can close this page now. Your episodes are imported and published on our server, also while you are away.
audio.stopConfirm: Stop this import? Episodes that are not published yet are cancelled, including ones already scheduled. Published episodes stay.
audio.maxReached: You can pick up to {{max}} episodes at once

free.title: Free plan: one video per day
free.body: On the free plan you can publish one video per day (Shorts: up to 3 per day), so the batch publishes one video per day. If you publish or schedule a video of your own meanwhile, the batch moves on to the next free day.
free.ends: The last one goes out around {{date}}.
free.pro: With 3Speak Pro they all go out today.
free.running: This batch uses your free daily publishing. If you publish or schedule a video of your own meanwhile, the batch moves on to the next free day.
free.bar: free plan: one per day, the rest follow later

rss.empty: No episodes found in your podcast feed.
rss.fallbackIntro: You can still import it: download the episode yourself and pick the file here. Everything else stays filled in.
rss.fallbackStep1: Open the episode at your podcast host.
rss.fallbackStep2: Download its audio file (MP3 or M4A).
rss.limits: Episodes up to {{hours}} hours can be imported. They are published as audio posts with their show notes and cover.
rss.unreadableAll: Your podcast feed cannot be read right now. Check that it is online, then try again later.
rss.progressTransfer: Loading the audio into the uploader: {{pct}}%

auto.title: Automatic import
auto.unavailable: Automatic imports are not available on this server yet.
auto.off: Off. Switch it on and every new episode of this show becomes an audio post on 3Speak.
auto.onSince: On since {{date}}. The feed is checked every {{minutes}} minutes.
auto.waiting: Waiting for tomorrow: {{count}} (at most {{max}} a day)
auto.skipped: Skipped, longer than the import limit: {{titles}}
auto.comesAuto: New episode: the automatic import takes it at its next check

errors.noLink: This feed is no longer verified on your profile. Link it again to continue.
errors.noGrant: 3Speak may no longer publish for you. Open the settings to allow it again.
errors.unreadable: Your feed could not be read at the last check. We try again at the next one.
errors.generic: The last check failed. We try again at the next one.

auto.formIntro: New episodes of {{show}} become audio posts with these settings, at most {{max}} a day, spaced out like a batch import.
auto.enabledInfo: We check your feed regularly. Every episode that appears after you switch this on is downloaded and posted for you by @threespeak, with the settings below. Episodes already in the feed are left alone.
auto.enabledOn: New episodes are posted for you
auto.enabledOff: The settings are kept, nothing is posted
auto.targetPostHint: A post with its title, in the community you pick below.
auto.targetSnapHint: A reply in the snaps feed, without a title, like a short. Community and blog do not apply.
auto.fromSourceInfo: On: each post takes its episode's title, show notes and the #hashtags in them, as your feed has them. Off: set the title format, tags and description yourself.
auto.fromSourceOn: Title, description and tags come from each episode
auto.fromSourceOff: You set the title, tags and description below
auto.titleHint: Use {title} for the episode title, {show} for the show name, {episode} and {season} for their numbers, {date} for the release date.
auto.tagsHint: Up to 8, separated by spaces. Added to every post.
auto.hashtags: Also use hashtags from the show notes
auto.hashtagsInfo: Words written as #tag in an episode's show notes become tags of its post, after your own tags (10 tags at most).
auto.hashtagsHint: #tags in the notes become post tags
auto.useNotes: Use the show notes as the description
auto.useNotesInfo: The post's text is the episode's show notes from your feed, with their links. Turn it off to use the same text of your own for every episode.
auto.useNotesOn: Each post shows its episode's notes
auto.useNotesOff: Every post uses your text below
auto.addendumHint: Added to every post after the notes, for example links to your other channels.
auto.textHint: Used for every episode. {title}, {show}, {episode}, {season} and {date} work here too.
auto.textRequired: Write the description to use, or use the show notes.
auto.onlyNew: Only episodes that appear in your feed after you switch this on are imported, never older ones.
auto.grantNeeded: Automatic imports are posted for you by @threespeak, so it needs permission to publish on your account.
